scripts.build:all: npm run build:i18n && npm run build:css
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run build:all
scripts.dev: npm run build:i18n && npm run dev:css
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run build:i18n:watch" "npm run dev:css" "npm run serve:node"
scripts.validate: npm run lint:i18n && npm run analyze:translations
scripts.pwa:icons: echo '请在浏览器中打开 icons/icon-generator.html 生成PWA图标'
scripts.watch:lang: nodemon --watch lang/*.json --exec "npm run build:i18n && echo 翻译已更新"
scripts.start: npm run build:all && npm run serve:dev
scripts.build:optimized: npm run optimize:prod && npm run build:all
scripts.deploy:prep: npm run build:optimized && npm audit fix
scripts.performance:check: npm run build:optimized && echo "Ready for Lighthouse testing"
scripts.test:functional: echo "请在浏览器中运行功能测试" && echo "localStorage.setItem('autoTest', 'true'); location.reload();"
scripts.monitor:performance: echo "性能监控已在生产环境自动启动"
scripts.deploy:build: npm run deploy:check && npm run build:optimized
scripts.maintenance:full: npm run optimize:prod && npm run test:quality && npm run deploy:check
scripts.dev:monitor: npm run dev && echo "开发环境监控已启动"
scripts.dev:test: npm run dev && npm run test:functional
